items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Jack Butler, a lot of them. We all met him at the boat

ctx.x: Yes. Between us, they were going to elect a new leader. So I got more votes than Jack did, so I became the leader of Harlem Gentlemen from ). (LAUGHTER).

And oh, there were things, we had a lot of, a lot of things happened shortly after I took over the band. We were booked in the Paramount Theater, with the Mills Brothers when they first were beginning. They had been singing, but this was in their early, early days.
